description: This file defines an interface class 'IPluginStarter' for starting plugins within a plugin system, providing a method to activate a plugin with retry parameters. It includes licensing information and a virtual destructor.

classes.name: IPluginStarter
classes.description: An interface for starting a Thunder plugin, providing a method to activate the plugin with retry logic.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Attempts to activate a plugin, retrying up to 'maxRetries' times with delays specified by 'retryDelayMs'. Returns true if activation succeeds within retries, false otherwise.
